title_zh: 荷兰艺术家蒙德里安的《构图三》在伦敦艺术品拍卖会上拍出2900万欧元的高价。
description: Dutch artist Piet Mondrian’s painting Composition III sold for £25,235,000, approximately €29 million, at Christie's in London on Wednesday.
description_zh: 荷兰艺术家皮特·蒙德里安的画作《构图 III》周三在伦敦佳士得拍卖行以 2523.5 万英镑（约合 2900 万欧元）的价格售出。

title: Days of heavy traffic due to school holidays, Amsterdam Marathon, Rotterdam roadworks
title_zh: 因学校假期、阿姆斯特丹马拉松和鹿特丹道路施工，交通拥堵数日。
description: The coming days will bring heavy traffic to many parts of the Netherlands.
description_zh: 未来几天，荷兰许多地区将出现严重的交通拥堵。

title: Netherlands unemployment rate remains at 4% for second consecutive month
title_zh: 荷兰失业率连续第二个月维持在4%。
description: The unemployment rate in the Netherlands has stayed unchanged at 4% for the second month in a row, Statistics Netherlands has reported. Unemployment rose to 4% in July, up from 3.8% in June.
description_zh: 荷兰统计局报告称，荷兰失业率连续第二个月维持在4%不变。7月份失业率升至4%，高于6月份的3.8%。

title: Ajax lose their first UEFA Conference League game of the season 2-1 away to Hajduk Split
title_zh: 阿贾克斯在欧足联联盟联赛首轮客场1-2负于哈伊杜克·斯普利特。
description: Ajax were defeated in their first matchday of the UEFA Conference League on Thursday. The Amsterdammers were beaten 2-1 away at Croatian side Hajduk Split.
description_zh: 阿贾克斯在周四进行的欧足联联盟联赛首轮比赛中失利。阿姆斯特丹球队客场1-2不敌克罗地亚球队哈伊杜克·斯普利特。

description_zh: 据报道，荷兰政府的新氮肥计划在民众中引发了深深的悲观情绪。

title: Former pro-cyclists and staff reveal unsafe culture at Dutch team PicnicPostNL
title_zh: 前职业自行车手和工作人员揭露荷兰车队 PicnicPostNL 存在不安全的工作文化
description: There is a culture of fear powered by an unsafe, rigid, top-down environment at the Dutch WorldTour cycling team Picninc-PostNL, previously known as Team Sunweb.
description_zh: 荷兰世界巡回自行车队 Picninc-PostNL（前身为 Team Sunweb）内部弥漫着一种恐惧文化，这种文化源于不安全、僵化、自上而下的环境。

title: Second fire at Berkel en Rodenrijs farm where dead body, drug lab were found 2 years ago
title_zh: 两年前在贝尔克尔和罗登里斯农场发现尸体和制毒窝点后，该农场再次发生火灾。
description: A farm shed on Noordeindseweg in Berkel en Rodenrijs completely burned out overnight from Wednesday into Thursday, releasing large amounts of smoke.
description_zh: 位于贝尔克尔和罗登里斯的诺德因德斯韦格的一处农舍从周三到周四夜间完全被烧毁，释放出大量浓烟。

title: Road rage driver chases woman to her TIlburg home, assaults her
title_zh: 一名路怒司机追赶一名女子至其位于蒂尔堡的家中，并对其进行殴打。
description: A 53-year-old woman from Tilburg was arrested Wednesday evening on suspicion of following another woman home and beating her up after a road dispute, police
description_zh: 警方称，周三晚间，一名来自蒂尔堡的53岁女子因涉嫌尾随另一名女子回家并在发生道路纠纷后殴打她而被捕。

title: World first: Southern ground hornbill gets 3D printed beak prostheses at Artis Zoo
title_zh: 世界首例：阿蒂斯动物园为南方地犀鸟安装3D打印喙假体
description: An injured southern ground hornbill at Artis Zoo in Amsterdam has received two 3D-printed prostheses to replace the broken upper and lower parts of its beak. And with great success.
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹阿提斯动物园一只受伤的南方地犀鸟接受了两个3D打印的假体，用来替换它断裂的上喙和下喙。手术非常成功。

title: Netherlands records third-warmest first half of autumn since 1901
title_zh: 荷兰经历了自1901年以来第三温暖的秋季上半月
description: The Netherlands experienced warmer and sunnier-than-average weather during the first half of meteorological autumn.
description_zh: 在气象学意义上的秋季前半段，荷兰的天气比往年更温暖、更晴朗。

title: RIVM confirms 5 new West Nile cases in the Netherlands while death toll remains at 10
title_zh: 荷兰国家公共卫生与环境研究所（RIVM）确认荷兰新增5例西尼罗河病毒感染病例，死亡人数仍为10人。
description: The West Nile virus has been confirmed in fivemorepeople in the Netherlands.
description_zh: 荷兰又有五人确诊感染西尼罗河病毒。

title: Dutch cult support service receives more than 250 requests for help in first year
title_zh: 荷兰邪教援助服务机构在第一年就收到了超过250份求助请求。
description: More than 250 people contacted a specialist Dutch support service for victims of cults and coercive groups during its first year, according to figures published on Thursday.
description_zh: 根据周四公布的数据，在荷兰一家专门为邪教和胁迫团体受害者提供支持的服务机构成立的第一年，已有超过 250 人联系了该机构。

title: Nazi-looted Kandinsky from Amsterdam family sold for almost €32m
title_zh: 纳粹掠夺的康定斯基作品，原为阿姆斯特丹一个家族所有，以近3200万欧元的价格售出。
description: A painting by Wassily Kandinsky looted from a Jewish family in Amsterdam has sold at Christie’s in London for £27...
description_zh: 一幅瓦西里·康定斯基的画作在伦敦佳士得拍卖行以27英镑的价格售出，这幅画作是从阿姆斯特丹一个犹太家庭被掠夺的……

title: Thousands of women abused in postwar Dutch camps, study finds
title_zh: 研究发现，战后荷兰集中营中数千名妇女遭受虐待
description: A study released Thursday by the NIOD Institute for War, Holocaust and Genocide Studies has found that thousands of women...
description_zh: 国家战争、大屠杀和种族灭绝研究所（NIOD）周四发布的一项研究发现，数千名女性……

title: No Picnic: inquiry reveals Dutch cycling team’s toxic culture
title_zh: 并非野餐：调查揭露荷兰自行车队的有毒文化
description: The Dutch cycling team Picnic-PostNL has been silently struggling with an oppressive atmosphere and culture of intimidation, according to an...
description_zh: 据报道，荷兰自行车队 Picnic-PostNL 一直默默地与压抑的氛围和恐吓文化作斗争……

title: MPs move to curb small schools amid cost and curricula concerns
title_zh: 议员们出于对成本和课程的担忧，着手限制小型学校的发展。
description: MPs and the cabinet want to curb the growth of small, independent schools in the Netherlands, after a school linked...
description_zh: 荷兰议员和内阁希望遏制小型私立学校的增长，此前一所学校与……有关。

title: Former freelancers quickly find employment, often in other sector: DNB
title_zh: 自由职业者往往能很快找到工作，通常是在其他行业：DNB
description: The number of self-employed individuals in the Netherlands has declined, yet this has barely led to an increase in unemployment, according to an analysis published by the Dutch Central Ba
description_zh: 荷兰中央银行发布的一项分析显示，荷兰的个体经营者数量有所下降，但这几乎没有导致失业率上升。

title: Locals set fire in Amsterdam, throw fireworks after rejection of New Year's bonfire plan
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹当地居民因新年篝火计划遭拒而纵火并燃放烟花
description: The area around Sneeuwbalstraat in Amsterdam-Noord was restless for hours on Wednesday.
description_zh: 周三，阿姆斯特丹北部的 Sneeuwbalstraat 附近地区持续数小时动荡不安。

title: Kandinsky painting looted from Amsterdam by Nazis auctioned for nearly €32 million
title_zh: 纳粹从阿姆斯特丹掠夺的康定斯基画作以近3200万欧元的价格拍卖成交。
description: A painting by the Russian-French artist Wassily Kandinsky (1866-1944), looted by the Nazis in Amsterdam in 1940, was auctioned off for nearly €32 million in London on Wednesday.
description_zh: 一幅由俄法艺术家瓦西里·康定斯基（1866-1944）创作的画作，于 1940 年在阿姆斯特丹被纳粹掠夺，周三在伦敦以近 3200 万欧元的价格拍卖成交。

title: Albert Heijn distribution centers start supplying stores again; Website still offline
title_zh: Albert Heijn配送中心已恢复向门店供货；网站仍处于离线状态
description: Albert Heijn is still struggling with the “cybersecurity incident” that took it and other Ahold Delhaize subsidiaries offline on Sunday afternoon.
description_zh: Albert Heijn 仍在努力应对周日下午导致其自身及其他 Ahold Delhaize 子公司下线的“网络安全事件”。

title: UWV abandons IT project after spending €55 million on it
title_zh: UWV在耗资5500万欧元后放弃了IT项目。
description: The Dutch Employee Insurance Agency (UWV) has pulled the plug on the development and implementation of a new digital system after five years.
description_zh: 荷兰雇员保险局 (UWV) 在历经五年后，终止了新数字系统的开发和实施。

title: Dutch consumers org. also sues Meta over AI glasses; Hearing set for November 26
title_zh: 荷兰消费者组织也起诉Meta公司，指控其人工智能眼镜存在问题；听证会定于11月26日举行。
description: The Dutch consumers' associationConsumentenbondis taking legal action
description_zh: 荷兰消费者协会Consumentenbonds将采取法律行动

title: TomTom plans to cut 200 jobs, roughly 6% of workforce
title_zh: TomTom计划裁员200人，约占员工总数的6%。
description: Dutch navigation system company TomTom is cutting approximately 200 jobs in a reorganization focused on making the navigation system provider “more focused, faster, and more scalable.” Th
description_zh: 荷兰导航系统公司TomTom正在进行重组，裁员约200人，旨在使这家导航系统供应商“更加专注、快捷、更具可扩展性”。

title: Woudenberg man sentenced to 4.5 years for raping his kids' babysitter for years

description_zh: 一名来自沃登贝格的 63 岁男子因多次强奸一名为他照看孩子的女孩而被判处 4.5 年监禁。这名女孩从 2019 年起为他照看孩子，当时她 16 岁。

title: Amsterdam foundation for vulnerable youth linked to €38 million money laundering case
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹一家致力于帮助弱势青少年的基金会卷入了一起3800万欧元的洗钱案。
description: The police are investigating whether an Amsterdam-based foundation aimed at helping vulnerable teenagers may be connected to a money laundering case involving some €38 million, the Telegr
description_zh: 据《电讯报》报道，警方正在调查一家位于阿姆斯特丹、旨在帮助弱势青少年的基金会是否与一起涉及约3800万欧元的洗钱案有关。

title: Police urge Ahold to file a report over cybersecurity breach
title_zh: 警方敦促Ahold公司就网络安全漏洞提交报告。
description: Dutch police and the Public Prosecutors Office have asked Ahold Delhaize, the parent company of Albert Heijn, to file a...
description_zh: 荷兰警方和检察院已要求 Albert Heijn 的母公司 Ahold Delhaize 提交一份……
